_comment: Machine-readable state (kit v1.3.1; optional fields models_used, tier, session_budget_usd, uses_defs, recheck, history may appear). pv-architect fills 'results' at /pv-setup; the coordinator keeps it current. The _example_* entries show every field and are ignored by the scripts. Field meanings: verification/rules/PIPELINE.md (stage/reason table, naming) and VERDICTS.md. Check with: python3 scripts/pv_status.py validate

_example_defs._note: use {"id": "NONE"} when the paper needs no shared definitions

_example_tool.meaning: one-sentence statement read from the Lean definition
_example_tool.provenance: i | ii | iii | iv | v | p (predecessor clause <ID>_<PredID>Consumed; set 'predecessor'). Gap hypotheses are NOT registered here (use the result's 'gaps')

_example_source_def.name: weighted negative Sobolev norm
_example_source_def.label: def:hminus
_example_source_def._note: one entry per defined object, with its own exact lines (v1.3.1)
